{{Quote|Way folks here see it, the Jedi recruited from Vaklin for centuries. Saved the best of us from the mines and the rust yards - even if our kids never come back, we could always watch'em on the Holonet. Plus what they did for us during the Clone Wars.|[[Djon]] to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]]|<ref name="TTF1" />}}
'''Vaklin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vaklin system/Legends|Vaklin system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Shula Shevu]]. A world deeply-seated in pro-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tradition, the planet was initially resistant to anti-Jedi propaganda by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but eventually succumbed to pressures from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Description==
[[File:Howling_Ruins.jpg|thumb|left|160px|The [[Howling Ruins]].]]

A [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] world of deep canyons with wall [[City/Legends|cities]] and fertile plains upon which cities were erected, the planet Vaklin had been depopulated at some point in its history before being repopulated by [[Trivak Ninegun]]. The [[Howling Ruins]], an ancient cliff-side city, were the talk of local legends and were left alone by the respectful locals not wishing to disturb the history which encompassed the ancient walls.<ref name="TTF1" />

==History==
===Honoring the Jedi===
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Vaklin suffered a worldwide depopulation during its history. The planet was recolonized by the [[Trivak Ninegun]] and a development in the planet's culture led to a devotion to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and its members. Located in unaligned space during the [[New Sith Wars]], the world suffered from a [[Rust plague]] at some point in its history, before the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Prokreisha]]. Adding to the legacy of the Jedi, the people of Vaklin would gladly turn over their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] newborns to the Order in hopes of having them escape the poverty and economic misfortune which plagued the world.<ref name="TTF2" />

[[File:Jedi_statues_Vaklin.jpg|thumb|left|160px|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] statues in [[Vaklin Zenith]].]]
Known for its [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and rust yards, the cities of Vaklin were diversely populated and its streets densely packed with vendors and individuals trying to make a living. Erecting parks and statues to their Jedi heroes, [[Northward Park]] was created with cuttings from the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Uro Koo]]. Deep within the [[Howling Ruins]], an ancient cliff side town, the Vaklin people established a [[Temple of Imperfect Repose|Jedi Temple]] as a place to take offerings and pay respect to the Jedi which played such a large part in planetary tradition.<ref name="TTF2" />

===Fall of the Order===
{{Quote|I seek to understand why they remain loyal to the Jedi. When we are finished understanding, we will use that knowledge to carve the heart from this rebellion. The people of Vaklin will awaken from the nightmare that was the Jedi Order and in the daylight of the new Empire, they will forget their heroes ever existed.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]]|<ref name="TTF1" />}}
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across the galaxy, the Jedi honored their long history with Vaklin and came to the planet's aid when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked. Dispatching [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and forces from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Republic and the Order were able to drive off the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], leaving only a few blocks of the capital city damaged. The people celebrated the success of the Jedi and gave thanks to the Order for their heroism in defending the rest of the city from annihilation. This latest show of protection bolstered enthusiasm for Jedi support which rose even more when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power at the end of the war and enacted the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="TTF2" />

When the Empire asserted its control over the planet, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cho'na Bene]] and two compatriots instigated the [[Vaklin insurgency]] against the invading Imperials. With the populace actively working against the Empire, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was dispatched to turn the people against the Jedi and put down the insurrection. Vader was successful in capturing and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|Jedi Master]] who aided Bene and the Master's [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|apprentice]]; holding the Barabel in a detention city within the city, the insurgents attempted to liberate the Jedi but all were killed during the attack, including the Jedi.<ref name="TTF1" />

Ordering the destruction of all Jedi related statues and memorials, Vader launched a campaign of erasing the Jedi support from the people. While initially unsuccessful, Vader was able to turn the people against the Jedi, leading them to abandon support of Bene and all stood by as the Jedi was shot down and killed in a public square. Vader left the planet in economic turmoil, with dozens of public areas destroyed, the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]] in ruins and the public support of Jedi sequestered behind fear and a new willingness to forget in order to survive.<ref name="TTF2" />
